model.name: SENTINEL-DESAL v1.2
model.note: Scores are 0-100; >=62 is cleared for normal intake. The conservatism term is a safety margin applied when the observation is old, never a bonus for freshness.

avoid_window.reason: Peak surface bloom coincident with tidal slack water.

best_window.text: Normal operations. Monitor intake differential pressure.

plants.name: Jebel Ali Desalination Complex

now.text: Throttle to 70 % and increase DAF pre-treatment dosing.

plants.rationale: Chl-a at the intake is 10.3 mg/m3 (WATCH). Scheduler weights the live retrieval at 96% confidence in ACTIVE mode, corrects for a 6 m intake depth, and avoids tidal slack water.

avoid_window.reason: Peak surface bloom coincident with tidal slack water.

best_window.text: Draw at full rate. Intake water clear.

plants.name: Fujairah F1 / F2 Desalination Complex

now.text: Draw at full rate. Intake water clear.

plants.rationale: Chl-a at the intake is 3.6 mg/m3 (CLEAR). Scheduler weights the live retrieval at 96% confidence in ACTIVE mode, corrects for a 10 m intake depth, and avoids tidal slack water.

basis.note: Capacity at risk is the fraction of rated output the intake scheduler would not clear to draw, not an outage. Population is that volume expressed at UAE per-capita domestic demand.
